adaptations: Three upstream slots reduced to pathology/RNA; the third slot is a constant placeholder, no CNA-like data is fabricated.
Attention MIL pooling of the 4096-row patch budget and an RNA input projection are applied outside the upstream module.
The bounded Cox output is replaced by discrete-hazard logits; the upstream encoder, gates, low-rank fusion and reconstructions are used as is.
The discriminator receives its own optimizer; upstream omits it from the optimizer and therefore never updates it.
The upstream third "fake" discriminator term is dropped because the placeholder carries no patient information.
Padded zero feature rows remain visible to MIL to match the legacy fixed-budget inputs.

settings.selection: maximum validation Harrell C, earliest exact tie
settings.metric_convention: legacy scoring plus separately labelled finite-edge audit
settings.batching: same epoch order and merged tail for all arms; minimum B=hidden+1
